action.reason: The branch modifies chat-host.ts (adds hostJobs field, sessionChanged() on session replacement, close() on host close), which the spec and US-009 explicitly put out of scope ('Any change to chat-host.ts'; close behavior belongs in createHostJobs.confirmClose; session invalidation via the sessionId() check). Spec wins: either revert those hooks or have a human amend the spec to allow them.

rationale: A concrete spec conflict found in the diff against the base commit. The change may be a deliberate safety improvement from commit a7c0d20fc, but the policy says the code follows the spec, and a human should decide whether to revert the hooks or amend the spec.
